secrets.name: DASHBOARD_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Passcode for the live results dashboard at /dashboard (chosen by the user in the Secrets page).

secrets.name: GOOGLE_APPS_SCRIPT_URL
secrets.description: Web-app URL of the Google Apps Script the user deployed from their own spreadsheet (Deploy > New deployment > Web app; execute as Me, access Anyone). Used by POST /api/export/sheets.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_APPS_SCRIPT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Shared token the user invented; the same value must be pasted into the TOKEN line of the Apps Script so the sheet rejects other writers.

production.note: Prod uses repo .env for secrets (DASHBOARD_PASSWORD required, Sheets export optional). TLS terminates in a host-level reverse proxy.
